finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
finding.summary: The req.body.comment field from feedbackController.js flows unsanitized through FeedbackService, NotificationDispatcher, and DigestEntryFormatter (which escapes only the author name, not the comment) across a 5-file chain before DigestPageRenderer.js embeds it in a template literal passed to res.send().
